name: Dumon
indication_summary: Benign & malignant central airway obstruction; carinal disease; fistulas
fistula_size_suitability: May leave small residual leak; still useful for sealing many TE/BE fistulas
location_notes: Trachea/mainstem/secondary carina; hourglass for short benign tracheal disease
advantages: Removable; radiopaque; customizable; studs reduce migration; broad sizes
limitations_and_risks: Thicker wall; requires rigid bronchoscopy; may not completely seal fistulas
best_for: Extrinsic compression; mixed lesions; post-debulking stabilization
cautions: Permanent stent for malacia rarely ideal

name: Polyflex
indication_summary: When thin wall advantageous; irregular stenoses
fistula_size_suitability: Not primarily designed for sealing; migration risk higher
location_notes: Straight segments; adapts to hourglass-type stenoses
limitations_and_risks: Smoother surface; sharper edges; migration; length varies with compression
evidence_notes: Tungsten spots for radiography; semirigid delivery
